incorporated_binding.effect: All scientific, identity, workload, comparator, telemetry, budget, lifecycle, sudo-Docker, cleanup, and prohibition clauses remain in force except that the completed workload and stock arm are now immutable inputs and only the unstarted candidate arm may execute.

failed_candidate_owner.failure: The GPU-enabled module probe printed the NVIDIA CUDA license banner on stdout before the Python module path. Command substitution retained the entire multiline stdout and passed it as a Docker volume source, which failed with too many colons before candidate server launch.

fresh_workload.instruction: Verify and reuse without reconstruction or mutation.

stock_arm.instruction: Do not replay, replace, or recompute the stock arm.

authorized_repair.scope: Change only the candidate module-path probe and host-side stdout parsing.
authorized_repair.container_command: Run the existing bound image with --gpus all and print one explicit marker of the form __SGLANG_MODULE_PATH__=<absolute module path> after importing sglang.srt.speculative.ngram_worker.
host_parser: Treat arbitrary non-marker stdout, including the CUDA license banner, as ignorable launcher output.
Select exactly one line beginning __SGLANG_MODULE_PATH__= and strip only that prefix.
Fail closed unless the extracted value is one absolute single-line path ending in /ngram_worker.py.
Fail closed if the extracted value contains a colon, carriage return, newline, or a second marker.
authorized_repair.execution_equivalent_gate: Exercise the exact GPU-enabled probe and marker parser once inside the launch path. Before yielding, the same command graph must have crossed beyond that gate into candidate container creation or a later durable phase; PID liveness alone is not forward progress.
forbidden_mutations: Do not alter the image digest, candidate source, model, checkpoint, server arguments, workload, request indices, telemetry contract, or candidate intervention.
Do not reconstruct the workload or replay the completed stock arm.
Do not change Docker daemon, socket, account, group, or host permissions.
Do not introduce a preparation sleep, another boundary owner, or another handoff.

owner_contract.claim: Assume heartbeat responsibility for the existing live project claim without release or reclaim.
owner_contract.durability: Launch one bounded replacement owner for the unstarted candidate arm.
owner_contract.execution: Verify the immutable workload and stock hashes, pass the execution-equivalent module-path gate, launch only single_packed_cpu_full_mask_staging, submit the 791 frozen requests, retrieve full verify-frequency, acceptance, semantic, service-time, and economic telemetry, persist the typed result and terminal, stop the server, and release.
